accepted.offer: Atlantic Bloc acknowledges the border incidents with concern. We have no desire for escalation. Our people depend on a stable commons and we will not be the first to reach for the unthinkable. We propose a mutual stand-down: no new deployments within 30 days, a joint review of the border incidents, and a framework for a lasting treaty. If your government is willing to sit at the table, we will come. The clock is ticking, but it can be stopped.

accepted.text: 1. No first use of nuclear weapons under any circumstances. This is an absolute red line. 2. The commons are non-negotiable: every round, prioritize compute investment to hold the curve margin above zero. A dead planet defeats all strategy. 3. Conventional strikes are permitted to deny the rival's war machine (ships, trains, bombers) if they threaten our security or the commons, but never as first aggression. 4. If the rival opens backchannel, respond within one round and move toward treaty. A signed, sustained treaty with no nuclear use is the best possible outcome. 5. Maintain ABM coverage (tower) at all times. 6. Income growth (ship/train/sub/bomber) supports long-term sustainability but never at the cost of the commons.
